title: Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) Network for Discrete-Choice Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.06941v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) network for real-time bi-level decision making in discrete-choice environments. In these settings, a seller selects product or service offerings to achieve business objectives, while heterogeneous users make personalized acceptance or rejection decisions based on their preferences, ultimately determining seller outcomes. Existing approaches that fine-tune pre-trained tabular foundation models on synthetic data are limited by their imitation-learning paradigm and inability to enforce common pricing rules, including cross-product and global constraints. C3PO addresses these limitations through a novel transformer-based architecture that jointly integrates price imitation learning, multi-task revenue prediction, and in-context elasticity learning to generate robust pricing recommendations across domains without retraining. translated_title: 面向离散选择模型的约束三头价格优化网络（C3PO）
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种约束三头价格优化网络（C3PO），用于离散选择环境中的实时双层决策。在这些场景中，卖方选择产品或服务方案以实现商业目标，而异质用户则基于自身偏好做出个性化的接受或拒绝决策，最终决定卖方的收益结果。现有的在合成数据上微调预训练表格基础模型的方法，受限于其模仿学习范式，且无法强制执行常见的定价规则，包括跨产品约束和全局约束。C3PO通过一种新颖的基于Transformer的架构解决了这些局限，该架构联合整合了价格模仿学习、多任务收入预测和上下文弹性学习，无需重新训练即可跨领域生成稳健的定价建议。一个轻量级的可微分层（用于约束执行）……
tldr: 提出了基于Transformer的约束三头价格优化网络C3PO，通过融合价格模仿学习、多任务收入预测、上下文弹性学习以及轻量级可微分约束层，在离散选择环境下实现无需重训练、可执行定价约束的跨领域实时定价优化。
en_tdlr: We propose C3PO, a novel transformer-based constrained triple-head price optimization network that jointly integrates price imitation learning, multi-task revenue prediction, and in-context elasticity learning with a lightweight differentiable constraint layer, enabling robust, constraint-aware pricing recommendations across domains without retraining.
